svg.title: Java 25 vs Go 1.25: Runtime Architecture, Memory, and Concurrency
svg.desc: Architectural comparison of Java 25 Generational ZGC and Project Loom Virtual Threads with Go 1.25 Green Tea GC and the GMP M:N scheduler.

svg.text: Java 25: Generational ZGC & Pointer Mechanics

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Colored 64-Bit Pointers & Load Barriers

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Metadata bits encoded directly inside reference pointers

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Load barrier intercepts dereference if object is relocating

svg.text: Result: Concurrent compaction with sub-millisecond pauses

svg.text: Generational Segregation (Young vs Old)

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Weak Generational Hypothesis: Most objects die young

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • High-frequency young gen collections save CPU cycles

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Scales effortlessly from 16MB to 16TB heap sizes

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Operational Trade-off: Higher baseline RSS memory footprint

svg.text: Go 1.25: Tri-Color GC & Green Tea Allocator

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Tri-Color Concurrent Mark-Sweep & Write Barrier

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Objects marked White, Grey, or Black concurrently

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Write barrier ensures shaded references are not collected

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Non-moving collector: Zero pointer fixup overhead

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Green Tea Allocator & Escape Analysis

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Aggressive stack allocation via compile-time escape checks

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Green Tea GC reduces mark overhead by 10%–40%

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Extremely compact memory baseline (~15MB–40MB RSS)

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Operational Trade-off: Heap fragmentation on erratic loads

svg.text: Continuations on Carrier Thread Pool

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • VirtualThread wraps stack continuation on Java heap

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Unmounts on blocking socket/file I/O to free ForkJoin worker

svg.text: • Preserves standard thread-per-request programming model

svg.text: • JIT Tiered C1/C2: Unmatched peak throughput on warm loops

svg.text: • Project Leyden CDS: Pre-computed training runs reduce startup

svg.text: Go 1.25 Concurrency: GMP M:N Scheduler

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Work-Stealing Runtime (G, M, P Model)

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • G (Goroutine, 2KB initial stack) dynamically grows/shrinks

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • M (OS thread) executes code bound to P (logical CPU context)

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Work-stealing algorithm rebalances run queues across cores

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Advantage: Zero carrier pinning; non-blocking channel select

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Compilation & Deployment Footprint

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Static Compilation: Fast build times, zero external deps

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Sub-100ms cold start; automatic cgroup GOMAXPROCS in K8s

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Container Image: ~12MB (Scratch-based static binary)

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Target: High-density microservices, proxies, and edge networks
